reason: The ceiling is far below the +0.002 public bar, and the part that looks large is either idle or already covered by existing stages. (1) Metric arithmetic: one FN edge turned into TP is worth 1/(TP+FP+FN) = 1/135,729 = 7.37e-6 (checked). The idea's +0.0087 upper bound double-counts: the 424 'detection-side FN at free ends' is a SUBSET of the 2,929 a_* FN (fn_anatomy_exp39.md, last line), so it overlaps a_tail (606) and a_never (1,907). a_never nodes do not exist, and the idea caps synthetic nodes at 1-2%. (2) The g=0 part is idle. On exp39 the final graph has 0 end->start pairs closer than 6 um (distance bins [0,6) all empty, 2 pairs in [6,8), fn_anatomy_exp39.json 'design'). CONTEXT.md also records that the motion relink leaves 0 end->start pairs within 5 um. x138's flow relink already runs a per-frame Hungarian over all sources against the flow prediction with a 7 um tight gate (DIFF.md cell 5). A 5 um g=0 gate therefore adds nothing. The recoverable g=0 pairs sit at 8-12 um: 120 TP / 318 FP among 12,511 pairs. Without an ILP edge, mutual-NN pairs are 6 TP / 216 FP, i.e. 2.7% precise. Geometry alone cannot pick them. The ILP-backed stitch took 115 of them for +0.0008 lab (l6 report sec.2), and the stitch is a closed line. (3) a_tail: the lab's own anatomy says 'only ~115 are ILP-attachable to a free end or start. A stitch placed before the short-track filter is worth little' (l6_fn_anatomy_report.md sec.4). 1-frame gap bridges are 28 (fn_anatomy) or 58 (l6 sec.4). These are already served by close_single_frame_gaps, gap2 and gapfill. Widening the gap radius 5 -> 6.5 um was LB -0.001 (CONTEXT A20: 'gap closing already saturated'), and velocity-projected gap closing was neutral locally (A7). (4) Precision of geometry-only links: gap1 edges have FP rate 0.34, gap2 0.42, relink_new_tight 0.76, relink_new_relaxed 0.84 among evaluable edges (anatomy_exp39.md). Upper-case reachable set is ~115 a_tail + <=58 bridges = ~173 FN. That is +0.0013 lab at 100% precision; at gap-edge precision 0.6 the net is ~+0.0005 lab (computed: 173 TP, 115 FP -> (173 - 0.914*115)*7.37e-6). x138's readmit/gapfill already take part of this, so the x138 ceiling is lower than exp39's. (5) Transfer: this does not lean on network confidence, so the lab-to-LB factor is ~0.5-1 (division insertion lab +0.0019 -> LB +0.001). That puts public at ~+0.0002..+0.0005, well inside the 0.003 LB noise, so the probe could not even resolve it. The anatomy gains are 6bba-concentrated: b_break 145/150 and a_tail 525/606 are in 6bba. The 44b6 stitch win rate was 15%. Whether the public embryo resembles 6bba is unknown. Node multiplier: LB min-len 4 = -0.002 and 8 = -0.001 show the rescued-fragment population is net non-positive on unseen data, and a geometric LAP would also keep junk fragments that are attached to real ends. Private may gain relatively more if unseen embryos break more (a guess), but even doubling the lab value gives <= +0.001. Fails the value lens: realistic public gain < +0.002.
fix_if_any: No repair reaches +0.002 public. Salvageable remnant, zero LB slots unless idle: drop g=0 entirely, since it is idle by construction. Restrict the LAP to g=2..3 with synthetic cap 0, i.e. pure re-association through existing nodes, placed before the short-track filter. Run it only as a cheap lab variant once the H3 x138 lab exists, alongside other tail tests. Pre-register the gate as delta >= +0.001 lab with both embryos > 0. Ship it only as a free rider bundled into a kernel that is already being submitted for another reason, never as its own probe. It cannot be measured on the LB (expected +0.0003 vs noise 0.003). If the team wants the ILP-backed version: a pre-filter ILP stitch (l6 st_all moved before the short-track filter) is the stronger variant of the same mechanism, but the lab already bounds it at ~115 edges = +0.0008.
